product_overview: VidScholar is a client-side web app that converts student queries into short, animated micro-lectures and provides a personalized learning dashboard. Users configure a lightweight profile, browse recommended lessons, and play adjustable difficulty animations rendered in-browser.
core_goals: Let a student create a lightweight profile (state, board, grade, favourite subjects) without registration so the app personalizes content
Provide a single-page dashboard that surfaces recommended or recent lessons and progress summaries
Generate and play short animated micro-lectures in the browser with adjustable explanation difficulty
Allow students to control lesson playback (play/pause) and change explanation depth live during a lesson
Persist profile and progress locally so users return to their personalized state

features.name: Onboarding Setup
features.description: Collect minimal student profile information (State, Curriculum Board, Grade, favourite subjects) so the app can tailor lesson suggestions and initial understanding scores.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select State -> Select Curriculum Board -> Select Grade -> Select favourite subjects -> Advance to the next onboarding step -> Submit onboarding to finish -> Navigate to /dashboard -> See personalized dashboard

Navigate to / -> Select only some required onboarding fields -> Attempt to submit onboarding -> See validation messages for missing required fields -> Complete missing selections -> Submit onboarding to finish -> Navigate to /dashboard

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Show a personalized student dashboard with progress indicators, recently generated lessons, and access points to open or resume lessons.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> See personalized progress summary and recommended lessons -> Choose a lesson to open -> Navigate to /lesson -> See lesson details and playback controls
Navigate to /dashboard -> See recent lessons list -> Resume a recently viewed lesson -> Navigate to /lesson -> Observe lesson resumed from last position

features.name: Lesson Interaction
features.description: Play, pause and adjust the explanation difficulty of an animated micro-lecture rendered in-browser; changes to difficulty influence the lesson's explanation style in real time.
user_flows: Navigate to /lesson -> Turn on/off difficulty setting to pick an explanation level -> Press play or pause on lesson content to start playback -> Observe animated micro-lecture playback with synced audio -> Press pause on lesson content to stop playback

Navigate to /lesson -> Press play or pause on lesson content to start playback -> Turn on/off difficulty setting while playback is active to adjust explanation depth -> Observe the lesson update its explanation tone and pacing -> Press pause on lesson content to stop playback
